anika: Hey team — quick design review request: I'm iterating on the API credentials banner + revoke/rotate modal. Attached: Figma link (https://figma.com/snap/xyz). Looking for feedback on copy tone, warning hierarchy, and keyboard focus order. drew: Thanks — overall looks clean. My only concern: the main banner uses strong red language but the rotate flow is less severe. We should avoid using the same warning style for rotate (which is reversible) as revoke (which is permanent). Maybe two distinct tones: amber for rotate, red for revoke. :warning: sam: Accessibility nits: when the revoke modal closes we need an aria-live announcement like "API key revoked" (polite) and then focus should return to the table row for that key. If we remove the row, focus should go to the next row or to the "Create key" CTA. Also keyboard order in the modal feels off — the cancel button is currently after the primary action in DOM, so tab order flips expectations. anika: Good call on focus. Proposal: after revoke success, show a 6s toast with undo and set focus to the toast so screen readers hear it, then move focus back to the list. For rotate, we show an inline success pill instead. Thoughts? leila: Love the undo toast idea. One copy tweak: current revoke confirm says "This action cannot be undone" — users skim and might miss context about downstream effects (deploys, integrations). Suggest expanding: "This will immediately invalidate the key. Any service using it will stop working." Short but explicit. drew: +1. Also, for teams with scoped keys, we should surface the perms in the modal header: e.g., "Revoke key • Write access to billing, Read access to logs" — short list. Helps support triage when someone asks "which key did you revoke?" sam: Quick aria snippet suggestion for the toast: ```html
API key revoked.
``` Make sure the undo button is focusable and announced. anika: Copy proposals (short): - Banner when a key is expired: "Key expired — rotate to restore access" - Revoke modal header: "Revoke API key" - Revoke body: "This will immediately invalidate the key. Any service using it will stop working. This action is permanent." - Revoke primary CTA: "Revoke key" (destructive red) - Revoke secondary CTA: "Cancel" leila: One more UX edge: for bulk revoke, we should surface an estimated impact count (approx. number of routes/apps using the key) — even if approximate it helps decide if they should rotate instead. drew: Regarding visual hierarchy: can we reduce the prominence of the inline permission list in the table row? Right now it competes with the key name. Maybe collapse into a hover / chip that expands on focus. anika: OK next steps: I'll update Figma with two warning states (amber vs red), add aria-live toast example, and tweak copy as suggested. I'll also prototype focus return behavior and a11y keyboard order fix. I'll post an updated screenshot in ~1h. Thanks! :sparkles: aria-bot: Note: design-review requested by anika. Reviewers: drew, sam, leila. Deadline: 24h.
